Ensure the timely and accurate feedback to new business quotes, develop and maintain component cost models, lead the implementation of BOM 2.0 activities, and generally support all functions with cost estimating and associated expertise

Lead and manage the cost estimation process for new business opportunities, ensuring timely, accurate, and competitive quotations that support customer acquisition and business growth.

· Develop, maintain, and continuously improve baseline Bill of Material (BOM) costing for assigned product lines.

· Create and maintain market-based target cost models using should-cost analysis, benchmarking, and open-book costing methodologies to evaluate supplier competitiveness and identify cost improvement opportunities.

· Analyze gaps between current production costs and market target costs, establishing actionable plans to achieve cost competitiveness and profitability objectives across assigned commodities and product lines.

· Develop and execute cost reduction strategies BOM 2.0 initiatives, new supplier development, and supplier negotiations..

· Lead the development and maintenance of USMCA component strategy and regional sourcing analyses to support compliance requirements.

· Partner with Engineering, Finance, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to identify and implement cost optimization opportunities throughout the product development cycle.

· Collaborate with suppliers to improve cost transparency, productivity, and overall value, while supporting supplier development initiatives that enhance quality, delivery, and commercial performance.

· Evaluate supplier quotations, cost breakdowns, and technical changes to ensure alignment with business objectives, target costs, and sourcing strategies.

· Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to costing and cross-functional teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making.

· Support business planning activities by developing cost roadmaps, forecasting financial impacts, assessing commercial risks, and recommending mitigation plans..

We are currently seeking an Engineering Co-op in our Auburn Hills, MI facility. If you are looking to enhance your career with a dynamic, growing company, then we encourage you to apply and join the JSS team!

What is This Opportunity?

The applicant will assist in the development and analysis of products, materials, processes, or equipment. Under direct supervision/guidance, he/she will compile, analyze, test, and research data for newly designed or modified airbags and parts. This is a great opportunity for a student to gain experience in the automotive industry, working with a dynamic team of professionals from around the globe.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Undertakes and successfully completes simple or basic project/product development tasks.

• May assist in inventing / creating concepts and designs/approaches for new products.

• Create sample requests for customer orders, validate parts/components for special builds.

• Designs and coordinates engineering tests and experiments.

• Support team on shipping parts and delivering samples to local customers.

• Create new part numbers and bill of materials (BOM) and release engineering orders (EO) in JSS systems.

• Issue CAD work orders for new drawings or current drawing modification.

• Prepares standard reports/documentation to communicate results to technical team.

• Completes basic tasks on engineering documentation.

• SolidWorks and Auto CAD knowledge is a plus.

• Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

• Must be currently enrolled in a Co-Op program with an accredited College or University as a full-time student.

• Pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Chemical Engineering.

• Must have and maintain a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.

• Authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Self-motivated, able to perform role with minimal supervision, taking ownership, with a sense of urgency.

• Able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Ability to work in a team environment to consistently achieve results.

• Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships with internal and external customers.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office, SolidWorks, and Auto CAD

• Knowledge of related engineering discipline functional and technical skills.

• Professional oral communication and writing skills.

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions

• Ability to lift 25 lbs

• Standing/Walking

Work Schedule/Location

• Required to work on-site work at our JSS Auburn Hills location.  Remote work is not eligible for this position.

• Work Schedule- 24 hours per week (3 X 8 hour days).

• Travel requirements- may travel locally as well as to a plant in Mexico or Moses Lake, WA

• Local candidates only.  Relocation/housing benefits not offered.

Additional Information The base compensation range for this role is: $23.00-$27.00.  The actual hourly wage offered will consider the candidate’s current academic level and degree candidacy. It will comply with state or local minimum wage requirements specific to the job location.

In addition to compensation, JSS offers a range of benefits designed to support our educational employees, including, but not limited to:

• Exposure to cutting edge safety technologies

• Company paid holidays

• Paid sick time per calendar year

• Collaborative work environment

• Networking with peers and leaders

Job Summary

The Analytical Chemist in the Armada Chemical Laboratory will perform quantitative analysis on chemical samples (raw materials and pyrotechnics) using advanced laboratory instruments. This role maintains strict quality control, troubleshoots instrumentation, and ensures compliance with ISO 17025.

Key Responsibilities

• Sample Analysis: Run tests on raw materials, in-process items, and finished products using techniques like high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), ion chromatography (IC), Inductively Coupled Plasma Optical Emission Spectroscopy (ICP-OES), and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

• Method Development & Validation: Develop, validate, and transfer analytical methods to support product testing and quality standards.

• Data Management & Reporting: Record experimental data accurately, interpret results, investigate out-of-specification results, and write technical reports.

• Equipment Maintenance: Calibrate, clean, and maintain complex lab instruments and handle troubleshooting.

• Regulatory Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols, company policies, and ISO 17025 guidelines during all laboratory operations.

• Inventory Control: Monitor and manage laboratory supplies, chemical reagents, and consumables.

• Quality Management System: Create and revise work instructions for various laboratory methods and procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Analytical Chemistry, or a closely related field is preferred, but not manditory.

• Experience: Working experience in a laboratory setting and the handling of hazardous chemicals.

• Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in HPLC, IC, FTIR, and ICP-OES.

• Strong data management and interpretation ability.

• Understanding of statistics and data analysis.

• Knowledge of ISO 17025 laboratory requirements.

• Soft Skills: High attention to detail, strong problem-solving capabilities, and effective written and verbal communication.

Ethics and Compliance:

• BS or higher degree in Engineering, Numerical Math or comparable subject

• Experience with the Global Safety Regulations and consumers ratings
